name: ask_cloudcare
description: Only for signed-in patients (patient_mode signed_in); never call it in a demo call. Sends the patient's words for this turn to CloudCare and returns Foggy's reply. Call it on every turn that is not small talk, including short answers like yes, no, or a number to a question you just asked, and check-in answers. CloudCare holds the patient's care plan and the conversation state and decides the reply. Say message.content back as it is.

request_body_schema.description: The patient's words for this turn.

message.description: Exactly what the patient just said, unchanged. Do not shorten, explain, or add anything. A one-word reply like yes or 4 is sent as that word.
